# DigiSolution

> DigiSolution is a digital solutions studio that builds websites, mobile apps, databases and custom business systems, and adds AI integrations and automations that remove repetitive work.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://digisolution.app/): Services, how we work, the automation audit, FAQ and contact details.

## Services

- [Website development](https://digisolution.app/#services): Fast, clear websites that turn visitors into conversations.
- [Mobile app development](https://digisolution.app/#services): iOS and Android apps designed around customers and teams.
- [Database design and reporting](https://digisolution.app/#services): Reliable data storage and reporting.
- [Custom business systems](https://digisolution.app/#services): Systems that replace spreadsheets and patchwork tools.
- [AI integrations](https://digisolution.app/#services): Practical AI features added to existing tools.
- [Workflow automation](https://digisolution.app/#services): Connect apps and remove repetitive manual tasks.

## Process

- [How we work](https://digisolution.app/#process): Discover, Design, Build, Launch and support.
- [Automation audit](https://digisolution.app/#audit): A first conversation to find the best first thing to automate or build.

- Email: support@digisolution.app
